description: Fantasy football rankings for a position in a given scoring format, ordered by points per game. Positions: qb, rb, wr, te, flex, k, def. Use this for "who are the best X" and draft board questions.

limit.description: How many players to return, newest ranking order.

position.description: Position to rank. flex covers RB, WR, and TE together.

scoring_format.description: Scoring format. ppr awards 1 point per reception, half_ppr 0.5, standard 0. Defaults to half_ppr, the most common league setting.

name: get_rankings

format_changes_order.description: False for positions that record no receptions, where every format gives the same order.

efficiency.description: Per-game and per-target rates. Each is null where its inputs do not apply.

position.description: QB, RB, WR, TE, K or DEF.

ppg.description: Points per game in each scoring format.

rank.description: Rank within the position, by points per game.

slug.description: URL segment for this player on draftcall.io.

stats.description: Season totals for the fields that apply to the position.

refreshed_at.description: When this dataset was last refreshed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

stats_season.description: The completed NFL season every figure in this result describes.

url.description: The draftcall.io page these figures came from. This is the citation to use.

title: Get fantasy position rankings
